audit.selection: Principal 46: original 43 plus qualified Maninjau N001/N002 and source-verified U1445B N005.
preserved_semantics: The original workbook and all 17 source columns remain unchanged.
Principal overrides: N001/N002 approximately 23 cm; N005 8 cm with verified hole coordinates.
N006 20 cm is an inclusion sensitivity only; no distribution is inferred from conflicting contacts.
Chala is gross preserved-deposit thickness, not solid-glass equivalent.
RC14-37 uses observed 15 cm, not reconstructed approximately 20 cm.
Malawi assumed thickness, Huguangyan hypothetical thickness and other held records are not constraints.
Approximate coordinates and preservation uncertainty are not propagated into model intervals.

nested_validation.assessment: Nested spatial validation of new-observation intervals. Outer responses do not enter candidate, weight or discrepancy fitting. No distribution-free coverage guarantee; censored sites contribute scores, not coverage.

volume.scope: Finite rectangle only; conditional on fitted component parameters and estimated weights. Mixture draws choose one component for the whole field; observation discrepancy is excluded.

domain.extent_rule: Complete physical Earth; no user-selected integration boundary.
domain.projection_method: Ellipsoidal Lambert azimuthal equal area, EPSG method 9820.

selected.scope: Model-conditional global bulk fallout on the complete WGS84 Earth. Not DRE or all eruption products. No global probability interval is estimated.
limitations: Removing the arbitrary rectangle does not identify unobserved deposit structure.
The existing planar trend and covariance are extrapolated through the equal-area projection; their global validity is an assumption.
Fitted-parameter, source-position, preservation and model-selection uncertainty are not integrated.
Refinement and phase agreement are numerical diagnostics, not rigorous error bounds or geological validation.

components.scope: Unconditioned trend plus marginal GP variance on an infinite plane; conditioned spatial correction omitted. Diagnostic only.

infinite_plane_background_diagnostic.scope: Weighted infinite-plane background only; not a physical fallout volume.

warnings: Predictive mixture; includes disagreement among retained candidates, conditional on each fit and estimated weights. Fitted-parameter uncertainty is not integrated.
Primary volume integrates the complete WGS84 Earth. It remains a model-conditional fallout estimate; distant tails are not independently validated.
Rectangle-based samples and intervals apply only to the regional diagnostic, never to global volume.
Legacy positive values are accepted as measurements unless flagged Pseudo; historical trace/absence encodings need provenance review.

Experimental ensemble: weights and new-observation discrepancy are fitted from spatial holdouts; only outer validation assesses their performance. No coverage guarantee. Discrepancy does not widen latent maps or volume intervals.
All volume estimates are bulk deposit volumes; no deposit-density conversion to DRE is applied by this workflow.
